name: Kriti Industries India Ltd
title: Kriti Industries India Ltd-$ - 526423 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: FY26 volume fell 13% to 58,630 MT and revenue fell 19%, but Q4 turned profitable with EBITDA margin 12.91% on a PVC inventory gain; management has put capex on hold for two quarters.

utilisation.quote: Plant utilization was fairly good, fairly comfortable in Q4.

capex.peers_comment: Management said most organized peers are adding capacity across regions, without quantifying it.
capex.quote: we are putting CAPEX on hold because we have already invested for all the developments and we will observe first two quarters

triggers.label: Capex on hold for two quarters
triggers.quote: we are putting CAPEX on hold because we have already invested for all the developments

triggers.label: Q4 utilisation above company average
triggers.quote: We are almost above average utilization for our company.

triggers.label: Q4 inventory build of INR 72 crore
triggers.quote: with a INR 72 crore inventory build driving profitability

guidance.value: INR 1,000 crore target (reiterated, no timeline change)
guidance.quote: we will definitely target towards our guidance
what ROCE can you expect at the targeted INR 1000 crore revenue and 10% margin by FY28?

guidance.value: Positive growth, above industry average, no number given
guidance.quote: we certainly look forward to a positive growth. And it should be in access to the industry average

prior_guidance_check.quote: we will definitely target towards our guidance

red_flags.label: Q4 profit driven by inventory gain and PVC price swings
red_flags.quote: as things are very volatile today, it is difficult to predict. But still, we may see some advantage on inventory side.

red_flags.label: Revenue guidance missed and reiterated without timeline
